meta_description: Wharncliffe Garden Services in Sheffield. Expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Call 07716 455076 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we'll bring your outdoor space back to life.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a major overhaul, or bespoke landscaping design, we've got the expertise.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, hedge trimming, and seasonal tidying. We keep your garden looking sharp year-round without the fuss.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your space from neglected borders and tangled growth. We clear, remove, and dispose of all waste responsibly.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts with new beds, pathways, patios, and planting schemes tailored to your taste and budget.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, reseeding, and treatment for moss and weeds. We'll restore patchy lawns to lush green condition.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, removal, and stump grinding. Safe, insured, and NPTC-trained where required.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Spring bulbs, summer bedding, autumn colour, and winter interest. We design and plant seasonal displays that evolve beautifully.

about_pullquote: We garden like it's our own backyard — with pride and real attention to detail.
about_para_1: Wharncliffe Garden Services was born from a simple frustration: too many gardeners treat properties as just another job. We started out over 15 years ago determined to do it differently — to listen to what customers actually wanted, and to deliver gardens that feel personal and well-loved. Today, we're still based in Deepcar, Sheffield, serving the whole city and surrounding areas with the same local care.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability and honest pricing. We turn up on time, complete work thoroughly, and clean up after ourselves — no hidden charges, no surprises. Most of our customers come back year after year, and many recommend us to their neighbours. That's not luck; it's because we genuinely care about getting it right.

reviews.text: Brilliant lads. Our garden was a total mess when we moved in — looked like a jungle. Within a couple of weeks Wharncliffe had cleared it all, laid new turf, and planted some gorgeous borders. Can't recommend them enough. Fair prices too.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Regular maintenance with Wharncliffe for three years now. They're reliable, do exactly what they say they'll do, and the garden's never looked better. The lads are friendly and professional. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Susan R.

reviews.text: Had a really overgrown back garden that other firms quoted a fortune for. Wharncliffe came and gave honest advice, reasonable quote, and the job was finished to perfection. Will be using them again for spring planting.
reviews.author: David K.
